items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was living across town by Booker Washington

ctx.x: And Frank Strozier playing on the amateur show, and they were rougher than me. And I said, “They went to Manassas.” So I was living across town by Booker Washington, but I had to get to Manassas cause I knew that’s where the stuff was.
